summary: Creates a duty for staff to notify Council of any inquiry for a facility drawing 20 MW or more, triggered at inquiry or preliminary meeting rather than at permit application.

source.citation: portland.gov District 3 councilor news release, September 17 2026

notes: The only trigger identified in this corpus that operates upstream of a permit application. Every other load threshold in the file attaches to an application, a rate class, or an interconnection request. Compare Hillsboro's 20 MW primary-use test in Resolution No. 2932, which attaches to a land use application.
confidence_note: Resolution not read. Whether the duty produces a published record or an internal one is NOT_CHECKED, and that determines whether it is a transparency instrument or an internal management one.
